## Vignettes

<div id="vignette-cards" class="fims-card-grid vignette-grid" aria-live="polite">
  <p>Loading vignettes…</p>
</div>

```{=html}
<script type="module">
  async function loadVignetteCards() {
    const container = document.getElementById("vignette-cards");
    const endpoint = "https://noaa-fims.github.io/FIMS/vignettes.json";

    const levelInfo = {
      "new-user": {
        label: "New User",
        className: "level-new-user"
      },
      intermediate: {
        label: "Intermediate",
        className: "level-intermediate"
      },
      "power-user": {
        label: "Power User",
        className: "level-power-user"
      }
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch vignette metadata: ${res.status}`);
      const vignettes = await res.json();

      if (!Array.isArray(vignettes) || vignettes.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = "<p>No vignettes found.</p>";
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = vignettes.map(v => {
        const title = v.title || "Untitled vignette";
        const summary = v.summary || "";
        const page = v.page || "#";
        const rawLevel = (v.level || "new-user").toLowerCase();
        const level = levelInfo[rawLevel] || {
          label: rawLevel.replace(/[-_]/g, " "),
          className: "level-default"
        };

        return `
          <div class="fims-card vignette-card position-relative ${level.className}">
            <div class="vignette-level-strip"></div>
            <div class="vignette-level-badge">${level.label}</div>
            <h3>${title}</h3>
            <p>${summary}</p>
            <div class="fims-card-footer">
              <a
                href="${page}"
                class="fims-btn-full stretched-link"
                aria-label="Go to the ${title} vignette"
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener"
              >
                Read vignette <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join("");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      container.innerHTML = "<p>Could not load vignettes.</p>";
    }
  }

  loadVignetteCards();
</script>
```
